verdict.rationale: PagerDuty can be driven without its UI. The REST API reads and changes account configuration, including users, workflows, on-call lookups and manual incident creation. The Events API v2 ingests machine events from monitoring tools and code repositories, webhooks send outbound callbacks, and an official local MCP server lets agents act on the account. One community report notes confusion between v1 and v2 Events API keys, a friction point rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific integration (e.g. a GitHub Actions or pipeline guide), documented non-interactive auth patterns for CI, and independent hands-on evidence of CI automation.
